_doc: Release rule (VT-3 stage 7): every rule ID a hook emits (a 'hook/slug' string in plugins/stage-pipeline/scripts/hooks/*-guard.mjs and journal-gate.mjs) has an entry with an incident fixture (the hook says no) and a legitimate fixture (the same hook lets the lookalike through). Each name is a text that occurs in scripts/hooks-test.mjs; validate.mjs fails on a rule with no entry, an entry that names a missing fixture, and an entry with only one of the two forms. Each entry also has a 'head': a literal stretch of the message the hook writes (it occurs in the hook's source). scripts/run-audit.mjs labels a denial by it, because the transcript shows the message and not the rule ID; rules whose message is shared (journal-gate's three) are labelled together. validate.mjs fails on a rule with no head or a head that is not in the hooks.
